devdoc.details: Paid in plain USDC for the same reason as the decryption credits: `transferFrom`      moves the whole price or reverts. What is bought is public; what it is spent on is      counted by the backend, which never lets an account spend more than it bought.      Unrelated to the collection: it never reads or writes DoNotOpen.

OwnableInvalidOwner(address).details: The owner is not a valid owner account. (eg. `address(0)`)

OwnableUnauthorizedAccount(address).details: The caller account is not authorized to perform an operation.

SafeERC20FailedOperation(address).details: An operation with an ERC-20 token failed.

owner().details: Returns the address of the current owner.

renounceOwnership().details: Leaves the contract without owner. It will not be possible to call `onlyOwner` functions. Can only be called by the current owner. NOTE: Renouncing ownership will leave the contract without an owner, thereby disabling any functionality that is only available to the owner.

transferOwnership(address).details: Transfers ownership of the contract to a new account (`newOwner`). Can only be called by the current owner.

devdoc.title: Studio packs

MAX_PRICE().notice: A pack above 100 USDC is refused, whatever the owner asks.

buy(address,uint256,uint256).notice: Buys pack `packId` for `account` (usually the caller), refusing to pay more than         `maxPrice` should the owner change the price meanwhile. The caller must have         approved this contract for the price.

packs(uint256).notice: The packs, by id. A pack with a zero price is not sold.

setPack(uint256,(uint256,uint32,uint32)).notice: Sets, changes or (with a zero price) withdraws a pack.

sketchesBought(address).notice: Units ever bought for each account.

treasury().notice: Where payments go, at once: the contract never holds funds.

userdoc.notice: The studio draws cats from a prompt through paid AI services. Its units are sold         here in packs, before anything is generated: so many sketches (cartoon pictures)         and so many 3D models for a fixed USDC price. The app's backend reads `PackBought`         and spends the units off-chain, one before each call to a service.
